Body & health 3

Talk about doctors, check-ups and wellbeing in Thai. This third part of Body & health moves from clinic visits to longer-term care — seeing a หมอ or แพทย์ (doctor), a ตรวจสุขภาพ (health check-up), getting your ผลตรวจ (test results), warning that you're แพ้ยา (allergic to medicines), and noting ผลข้างเคียง (side effects). It also covers mental health — เครียด (stress), ซึมเศร้า (depression) and seeing a นักจิตวิทยา (psychologist). All 25 sentences come with native-speed audio, English translations and word-by-word notes, so the vocabulary settles in by ear.

Doctors & wellbeing

2 แพทย์…

Thai has two words for "doctor": หมอ (everyday, colloquial) and แพทย์ (formal/written, also in compounds like จิตแพทย์ "psychiatrist").
